channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-iot
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Coffee Edition — via awesome-iot
item.description: A newspaper your printer prints every morning: a Claude routine writes it overnight from your notes, GitHub Actions lays it out and checks every page, a Raspberry Pi Pico W prints it.

item.title: Snappy Ubuntu — via awesome-iot
item.description: Snappy Ubuntu Core is a new rendition of Ubuntu with transactional updates. It provides a minimal server image with the same libraries as today’s Ubuntu, but applications are provided through a simpler mechanism.

item.title: ESP32 iPhone Agent — via awesome-iot
item.description: An ESP32-S3 plugged into an iPhone acts as a Wi-Fi-controlled USB mouse and keyboard, so an AI vision model can operate the phone through AirPlay screen mirroring.

item.title: AIOTI — via awesome-iot
item.description: The Internet of Things Innovation (AIOTI) aims to strengthen links and build new relationships between the different IoT players (industries, SMEs, startups) and sectors.

item.title: Mqttable — via awesome-iot
item.description: Desktop MQTT workbench for traffic inspection, replay, load testing, fault injection, and PCAP analysis.

item.title: AimDB — via awesome-iot
item.description: Data ingestion layer for distributed systems with typed contracts, safe schema evolution and one place to see and manage every node, from microcontroller to cloud. Runs on no_std microcontrollers (Embassy) and Tokio, with MQTT, KNX and serial connectors.

item.title: Awesome NFC — via awesome-iot
item.description: A curated list of tools, libraries, hardware, and guides for working with NFC tags.

item.title: mqttkit — via awesome-iot
item.description: Elysia-style application framework for MQTT in TypeScript / Bun. Compose broker adapters, ordered middleware, typed topic routes, MQTT 5 RPC, and AsyncAPI 3.0 docs on top of Aedes or any MQTT broker.

item.title: TinkerNews — via awesome-iot
item.description: A free weekly newsletter curating noteworthy DIY electronics builds across ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and IoT. Each issue gives a concise introduction to practical projects and links back to the original tutorial, article, or repository so readers can explore the details and build from the source.
